messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a concrete timeline for the GPU capacity remediations, plus owners. I sketched a proposal below.

Evan: Ack. Can you paste the proposal here?

Priya: TL;DR: three workstreams — (1) quota uplift requests (cloud), (2) scheduler tuning + better preempt policy, (3) formal headroom definition and automated detection. Proposed owners: Evan -> quota, Nora -> scheduler, Suresh -> headroom & detection. Target: triage -> plan in 72h, implementation in 2 sprints for critical items.

Nora: Sounds good. For scheduler tuning I want a short list of concrete knobs to test (bin packing, preemption thresholds, backfill window). Will need a canary on staging first.

Suresh: For headroom I propose we define both static (min GPUs per region) and dynamic (percentile-based) headroom. Also add an alert on 95th token/second sustained that triggers preemptive scale.

Evan: I'll open the quota ticket with cloud ops today. ETA by EOD for initial request. I'll put proposed commit amounts and cost impact.

Priya: Great. Owners + mini-checklist:
- Evan: create GA ticket + cost note + owner for follow-up
- Nora: scheduler experiments plan + staging canary + test matrix
- Suresh: headroom definition doc + alert rules + sample detection queries
- Ops-Lead: coordinate dedicated pool reservations if quota delayed

SRE-Bot: Incident 2270018001 -> postmortem created. Related: 2270018345. Reminder: action items auto-added to remediation board. :bell:

Evan: @Ops-Lead adding you to the quota request thread. If cloud says long lead, we should request temporary burst pool.

Ops-Lead: Noted — I'll check current reserved pools and blocked requests. If quota windows are >3 weeks we'll use burst plan and flag cost center.

Priya: Recurring pattern note: this is the 4th surge in last 6 months with similar root causes (sudden demand spikes + insufficient headroom). We should create a recurring retro item to track regressions and verify remediation persists.

Nora: Agree. Propose a 30-day regression check: run a synthetic workload simulating 2x traffic for 1 hour and validate autoscale and queue time. Add to weekly ops cadence.

Suresh: I'll add detection dashboards (p95, queue time, preemptions) and a scheduled smoke test job. Also adding a runbook snippet for emergency manual rehome of jobs.

Priya: Timeline recap:
- Today (T0): Evan opens quota ticket, Ops-Lead audits reserved pools
- +72h: owners present concrete plan & staging test matrix
- Sprint 1 (2 weeks): scheduler knobs + canary, headroom doc + alerts, quota initial approvals
- Sprint 2 (weeks 3-4): rollout of tuned scheduler, automated detection & smoke tests, final quota adjustments

Evan: Marking myself done for "open quota ticket" once I paste ticket link.

Evan: https://tickets.internal/INC-5421 — quota request created, assigned to cloud-quotas. Added cost estimate and priority header.

Priya: Nice. I've created a single-line tracker in the remediation board and linked tickets: https://remediate.internal/board/22345. Please add checkboxes as you complete items.

Nora: Quick question — for canary, what size GPU instances do we use? Recommend identical instance types as prod but 10% of workload. Thoughts?

Suresh: Use same instance type + half the batch size for safety. We'll monitor KV cache eviction and latency.

Priya: Cool. We'll meet for a 20-min sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm the staging matrix and assign subtasks. If owners can't make it, post updates in this thread. :calendar: :thumbsup:

Ops-Lead: Will attend. I'll bring current reserved pool numbers and any pending approvals.

SRE-Bot: Reminder scheduled: 2270022800 - "GPU capacity owners sync" set by Priya.

Priya: Closing notes — please add any additional risks here. Also flag if any remediation requires budget sign-off (Ops-Lead/Evan). Otherwise we'll proceed with the plan.

Evan: flagged cost center; already in ticket.

Nora: Added scheduler test checklist to staging repo: https://git.internal/redwood/scheduler-tests/pull/12

Suresh: Headroom doc draft uploaded: https://docs.internal/headroom/draft-v1 — comments welcome.

Priya: Thanks team. We'll use this thread to capture the small updates. If anything blocks the 72h checkpoint ping me directly. :sparkles:
